definitions.explanation: To spend one or more nights at a hotel, inn, or other accommodation.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宿泊|しゅくはく}した。
⟦{温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}→温泉旅館：25209_onsenryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧{宿泊|しゅくはく}する⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I plan to stay one night at a hot spring inn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ビジネスホテル→ビジネスホテル：25688_bijinesuhoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{三泊|さんぱく}{宿泊|しゅくはく}することになった。
examples.english: I ended up staying three nights at a business hotel in Osaka for a work trip.

notes:
A formal word for staying overnight at an accommodation. More formal than ⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧, which is the everyday equivalent. {宿泊|しゅくはく}する is commonly used in hotel and travel contexts, on booking websites, and in written announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宿泊|しゅくはく}する: to stay at a hotel
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{宿泊|しゅくはく}する: to stay at a Japanese inn
- ⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧: one-night stay
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: accommodation fee
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}→宿泊：03216_shukuhaku⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: accommodation reservation
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}{施設|しせつ}→宿泊施設：16474_shukuhakushisetsu⟧: lodging facility
- ⟦{宿泊|しゅくはく}{客|きゃく}→宿泊客：30262_shukuhakukyaku⟧: hotel guest

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay overnight — everyday word, used in casual speech
- ⟦{滞在|たいざい}する→滞在する：26834_taizaisuru⟧: to stay, to reside — focuses on the duration of a stay, not specifically overnight
